column3: Pairs covenant fulfillment with God's unfailing promise in a reciprocal commitment.

Extends fulfillment to undiminished recompense at final accounting.
Links kept allegiance to a great reward and breached allegiance to self-harm.
Gives the immediate contrary case of selling God's covenant and oaths for little value.

Shows steadfast completion of what was pledged to God without substitution.
Requires completing a covenant through its term for parties who have not violated it, with the same love-of-muttaqin ending.
